title: In-House AI Banking Assistant (Hijra Bank)
description: Launched an in-house conversational banking assistant, to production through a limited-user rollout, enabling users to access transaction insights/history and execute banking transactions via chat; also used in investor demonstrations.

title: Host-to-Host API (BI SNAP Protocol)
description: 0→1 discovery, technical specification, and enterprise integration with Bank Indonesia's National Standard Open API (SNAP). Unlocked institutional cash management for enterprise B2B partners.

title: Core Banking Engine Migration (CBS)
description: Migrated the bank's mission-critical core ledger and batch reconciliation services from costly monolithic vendor software to lean cloud infrastructure with zero account downtime and zero customer complaints.

title: Automated KYC & Onboarding Funnels
description: Redesigned digital customer onboarding with biometric optical character recognition (OCR) and automated Dukcapil verification, shrinking completion time from hours to under 5 minutes while maintaining strict AML compliance.
